description: Presidential Secretariat -  Proclamation made to declare that Keppetipola late Disawe of Ouva 18 others Sinhala Leaders as War Heroes who fought out of patriotism for an Independent Sri Lanka
reasoning: This gazette content is a proclamation by the President that revokes and annuls a historical legal declaration from 1818. It deals with the legal status of historical figures, declaring them war heroes instead of traitors. This constitutes a legal/regulatory matter involving the modification of a previous legal proclamation and declaration, fitting Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) which covers legal amendments, repeals, and statutory declarations.
